subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Habitual
solution:
The correct answer is: **Continuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"habitual"** means something that is done regularly or repeatedly; it is a habit or practice that one engages in frequently. (आदतन)

 
 
• **Example:** He is a **habitual **latecomer, always arriving after the meeting has started.
 
 
 
• **"Continuous"** refers to something that is uninterrupted and ongoing over a period of time. (निरंतर)
 
 
• **Example:** The **continuous** rain made it impossible to go out for a walk.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'habitual'** is **'continuous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Considerate** (विचारशील): Showing careful thought and regard for the feelings or needs of others.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very considerate and always thinks about how her actions will affect others.
 
 
 
• **Diverse** (विविध): Showing a great deal of variety; very different.
 
 
• **Example:** The city is known for its diverse cultures and communities.
 
 
 
• **Pertinent** (प्रासंगिक): Relevant or applicable to a particular matter.
 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer asked several pertinent questions during the trial.
 
 

40:Td47,

The correct answer is: Option 4<
